description.en: An OMP-inspired compact UI for DSH 0.2.1-rc.2, with light/dark themes, plain messages, model and reasoning controls, context usage and native task controls. Distributed as a prebuilt GitHub release bundle.
description.zh: 适配 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 的 OMP 风格紧凑界面，提供深浅色主题、无边框消息、模型与推理等级切换、上下文占用和原生任务入口，通过 GitHub Release 分发预构建 bundle。
